decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is used).
Condition : 4 - The extension [building] hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as No. 25 Lampton Park Road.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank (southern) wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The garage shown on drawing No. J:3:5 with revisions Jun 03, Aug 03 and Sep 03 shall be used for the accommodation of private vehicles only and in particular no trade or business shall be carried on therefrom.
description: Erection of a two storey front extension, first floor side extension, and single storey garage extension to side of dwellinghouse.
